title: Verify new patient can register with valid details
preconditions: Registration system is available and user has valid identification

steps.action: Navigate to the patient registration form

steps.expected_result: System creates patient record and displays confirmation

expected_outcome: Patient is registered with a unique patient ID
given: A new patient with valid identification documents
when: The patient fills in the registration form and submits
then: The system creates a patient record and assigns a unique patient ID

title: Validate registration with missing required fields

steps.action: Navigate to the patient registration form
Leave required fields empty and submit

expected_outcome: System prevents registration and highlights missing fields
given: A new patient on the registration form
when: The patient submits the form with required fields left empty
then: The system displays validation errors for each missing required field

title: Verify appointment can be scheduled for available slot
preconditions: Patient is registered and doctor has available slots

steps.action: Search for a doctor by specialty
steps.expected_result: List of available doctors is displayed

expected_outcome: Appointment is booked and confirmation is sent
given: A registered patient and a doctor with available appointment slots
when: The patient selects a doctor, picks an available time slot, and confirms
then: The system books the appointment and sends a confirmation notification

title: Validate booking already-taken appointment slot
preconditions: Patient is registered and the target slot is already booked

steps.action: Search for a doctor by specialty

expected_outcome: System prevents double-booking and suggests alternative slots
given: A registered patient and a doctor whose target slot is already booked
when: The patient attempts to book the already-taken time slot
then: The system prevents the booking and suggests alternative available slots
